hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a symmetric quadratic effect of x4: predictions are too low when |x4| is large and too high when x4 is near zero.
rationale: All six positive residuals (+0.23 to +0.24) have |x4| of at least 1.03, split evenly between signs (-2.914 and +2.962 both appear). All four negative residuals (about -0.24) have |x4| at most 0.25, so an even function of x4 separates the two groups cleanly.
